cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Exactly as Planned
cards.instruction: Treat every exposed flaw, failed step, and unexpected consequence as proof that the scheme is unfolding by design.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Mum found the surprise invitations. That puts us precisely on schedule.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I hid them in my sock drawer like you told me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Concealment and permanent loss are different things. You gave her something worth discovering. Well done.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She's cancelling the caterer. Should I stop her?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No. Confirm the cancellation for her. I won't have you undoing the control stage now it's working.

reason: The helper's actual stop-or-help question gives A a professional correction to make; A treats Mum's cancellation as a preplanned stage and makes B facilitate it.
